description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Substitution' for sed-style variable substitution within strings, supporting ${xxx} format variables, method execution on variables, macro evaluation, and predefined variables like ${TODAY} and ${RANDOM}. It includes internal classes and methods for variable resolution, macro parsing, and method execution.

classes.name: Substitution
classes.description: Main class providing variable substitution, macro evaluation, and method execution functionalities.

classes.name: InternalSource
classes.description: Internal class implementing SubstitutionSource to provide predefined variables like ${TODAY}, ${YESTERDAY}, ${TEMP_DIR}, and ${RANDOM}.

methods.name: copySubstitution
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing Substitution instance with its sources and resolvers.

methods.name: addGlobalMethodResolver
methods.description: Adds a MethodResolver to the static global list for use by all Substitution instances.

methods.name: addSubstitutionSource
methods.description: Adds a SubstitutionSource to the current instance.

methods.name: addMethodResolver
methods.description: Adds a MethodResolver to the resolvers list.

methods.name: isIgnoreMacros
methods.description: Returns whether macro processing is ignored.

methods.name: setIgnoreMacros
methods.description: Sets whether to ignore macro processing.

methods.name: substitute
methods.description: Performs variable substitution on the input string, processing ${xxx} patterns and macros.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Resolves a variable name (with optional method calls) to its value.

methods.name: legacySubstitute
methods.description: Performs substitution for legacy @xxx@ style variables.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Parses and evaluates a macro expression line.

methods.name: corresponding
methods.description: Finds the matching closing brace for a given opening brace in a string.

methods.name: runMethods
methods.description: Executes a list of methods on a source object, supporting nested method calls.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Extracts method names from a string with dot notation.

methods.name: trimMethod
methods.description: Removes arguments from a method string.

methods.name: getMethodArgs
methods.description: Parses method arguments from a string.
